external_collaboration.evidence_quote: EUWATCH brings together five watchmaking education partners from Finland, Denmark, Germany, Sweden and France: Kelloseppäkoulu / Kellosepäntaidon Edistämissäätiö sr, Zealand Business College, Berufliche Schule Farmsen BS19, Institutet för Högre Urmakeriutbildning i Norden AB and Lycée Polyvalent Edgar Faure. Together, the partners combine their expertise, teaching methods and traditions to develop European watchmaking education.
